description: Find anti-dumping, countervailing, safeguard and steel regulations from Official Journal publications. Use this for regulatory actions; trade_list_quotas returns quota tables, while current duty rates and remaining balances require TARIC. CN matching works in both prefix directions, using the first eight digits of a TARIC code; filters narrow together. Returns measures with action, instrument, products, origin countries, extracted CN/TARIC codes, EUR-Lex URL and observed_at, plus next_cursor and feed freshness. Reuse next_cursor with the same filters to page or poll stored acts; extracted codes do not establish a binding duty rate. For a known act, use HTTP GET /v1/eu/trade-defence/measures/{celex}; the OpenAPI contract documents the exact CELEX input. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

action.description: One kind of action only Allowed: provisional, definitive, amendment, extension, repeal, termination, registration, initiation, quota, other; e.g. provisional.

cn.description: CN/TARIC code, 4 to 10 digits after removing spaces and dots, e.g. 7208 or 72085120

country.description: Origin name substring, 3 to 60 Unicode letters or spaces/punctuation (period, apostrophe, parentheses, hyphen), e.g. China; omit for all origins

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; t followed by 1 to 12 digits, e.g. t0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

instrument.description: One instrument only (steel: acts under the EU steel regime, Regulation 2026/1384) Allowed: anti-dumping, countervailing, safeguard, steel; e.g. anti-dumping.

since.description: Regulations dated on or after, YYYY-MM-DD; e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

name: trade_list_measures
title: List EU trade defence measures
